tests.reason: The change is in a Supabase edge function, which is not part of the frontend build staging serves and deploys only by a manual dispatch to the single (production) Supabase project. Invoking it writes recommendation rows for the caller, so no read-only staging probe can exercise it. The Vitest suites prove the Bedrock-only source contract, the pinned model, the validator on both answer paths and the retired function; the post-deploy check is read-only (deployed source + logs).
